mainEntity.name: Can AEO help my roofing business get more reviews and testimonials?

acceptedAnswer.text: While AEO's primary goal is to provide direct answers and increase visibility, it indirectly supports generating more reviews and testimonials. By appearing as an authoritative source in answer engines, your roofing business builds trust and credibility even before direct engagement. This initial positive impression can make customers more inclined to choose your services. After a positive service experience, satisfied customers are more likely to leave reviews when prompted, especially if they initially found you through a trusted AI source. AEO helps position you as a reliable provider, fostering a greater propensity for positive feedback.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO indirectly helps generate more reviews by building trust and credibility, as your business is seen as an authoritative source in answer engines. This makes customers more likely to choose you and leave positive feedback.
